src: workspace foreground object s outside the catalog
dst: catalog template sprite d touching the catalog background
match_cond: s equals a distinctive color mask, an edge-color filled bbox, or a multicolor boundary window of d
transform: stamp the full d at the aligned offset, treating catalog-background cells inside d.bbox as transparent; leave unmatched objects unchanged
symbol_instructions: large non-black catalog region lists the full target sprites used as templates
